dish.title: Moroccan Seven-Vegetable Couscous
dish.description: Fluffy couscous crowned with a fragrant ras el hanout broth of carrots, turnips, butternut squash, cabbage, zucchini, tomato, and onion, simmered until tender with ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, and plump raisins. Served with harissa for heat.

recipe_version.title: Moroccan Seven-Vegetable Couscous
recipe_version.description: Fluffy couscous crowned with a fragrant ras el hanout broth of carrots, turnips, butternut squash, cabbage, zucchini, tomato, and onion, simmered until tender with ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, and plump raisins. Served with harissa for heat.

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.preparation: half tied in a bundle, half chopped

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the onion into wedges. Peel and cut the carrots, turnips, and squash; cut the cabbage into 2 wedges and the zucchini into lengths. Grate the tomatoes on a box grater and discard the skins. Tie half the cilantro into a bundle and chop the rest.

steps.title: Sauté the base
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then stir in the ras el hanout, ginger, turmeric, and pepper for 30 seconds and add the grated tomatoes.

steps.title: Simmer the hard vegetables
steps.body: Add 6 cups water, 2 1/4 tsp salt, the cinnamon stick, the cilantro bundle, the carrots, turnips, and cabbage. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered 25 minutes.

steps.title: Add the soft vegetables
steps.body: Add the squash, zucchini, and raisins and simmer until everything is tender, 15 minutes.

steps.title: Steam the couscous
steps.body: During that last simmer, put the couscous in a heatproof bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt, pour over 1 3/4 cups boiling water, cover with a plate, and let it stand 10 minutes; fluff with a fork. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the cilantro bundle and cinnamon stick. Mound the couscous on a platter or in wide bowls, arrange the vegetables on top, ladle over the broth, and scatter the chopped cilantro. Thin the harissa with a ladle of broth and serve alongside.

equipment: medium heatproof bowl with a plate to cover
